Requirements: R-9
Plan row: TS-11

Obligations: OB-14. Q6: the checked breadth is everything configurable at project creation; completeness of that list goes to the testing report.

## Given
- Source and target projects created with known values for every setting the project-creation API accepts (the list is read from the create contract by the automator and recorded in the test).
- One integration in the source.

## When
1. Snapshot both projects (detail read of every creation setting) and both integration lists.
2. Move the integration by PUT with project_name = target.
3. Snapshot again.

## Then
1. P-source and P-target: every creation setting of both projects equals its value before the move.
2. The source integration list lost exactly the moved id and nothing else.
3. The target integration list gained exactly the moved id and nothing else.

## Self-probe notes
- Discriminating input: values are set non-default at creation so that a reset to default shows; before values come from the seed and the pre-move snapshot.
- Snapshots are separate reads from the move call. Allowed dynamic fields (updated timestamps) are normalized, nothing else.
- Open: whether the list is complete is a report question, not asserted here.
